landing.heroSubtitle: MindBridge connects psychiatrists and psychologists with their patients for daily mental health tracking, real-time alerts, and secure messaging -- all in one calm, focused platform.
landing.features.title: Everything you need for continuous care
landing.features.subtitle: Simple, secure tools for both practitioners and patients.
landing.features.journaling.title: Daily Journaling
landing.features.journaling.description: Patients log mood, sleep, anxiety, and medication daily with an intuitive, low-friction form.
landing.features.analytics.title: Visual Analytics
landing.features.analytics.description: Practitioners see mood trends, sleep patterns, and medication adherence in clear, actionable charts.
landing.features.alerts.title: Smart Alerts
landing.features.alerts.description: Automatic alerts when mood drops, medication is missed, or sleep becomes critically low.
landing.features.messaging.title: Secure Messaging
landing.features.messaging.description: Direct messaging between practitioner and patient for quick check-ins between appointments.
landing.features.access.title: Role-Based Access
landing.features.access.description: Patients see only their own data. Practitioners see only their assigned patients.
landing.features.calm.title: Calming Experience
landing.features.calm.description: Designed for minimal cognitive load with a clean, accessible interface that puts wellbeing first.
landing.demo.title: Try the demo accounts
landing.demo.subtitle: Explore MindBridge instantly with pre-loaded demo data. No registration required.
landing.footer.psychiatristCta: Are you a psychiatrist? List your practice on MindBridge →
landing.hero.subtitle: Track your patients' mood, sleep and adherence between consultations. Spot the changes that matter, and arrive prepared at every session.
landing.mockup.overview: Your patients at a glance today
landing.feat.title: Everything you need for continuous care
landing.feat.subtitle: Simple, secure tools for practitioners and patients.
landing.feat.journal.title: Daily journal
landing.feat.journal.desc: Patients record their mood, sleep, anxiety and medication every day through a simple, intuitive form.
landing.feat.analytics.title: Visual analytics
landing.feat.analytics.desc: Practitioners see mood, sleep and medication adherence trends in clear, actionable charts.
landing.feat.signals.title: Clinical signals
landing.feat.signals.desc: MindBridge flags the changes that deserve your attention — falling mood, missed medication, critical sleep — without ever making a diagnosis.
landing.feat.messaging.title: Secure messaging
landing.feat.messaging.desc: Message your patients directly, for follow-up that is quicker and more human.
landing.feat.roles.title: Role-based access
landing.feat.roles.desc: Patients only see their own data. Practitioners only see the patients assigned to them.
landing.feat.reports.title: Clinical reports
landing.feat.reports.desc: Generate structured or narrative reports to support your consultations and follow-up.
landing.help.paragraph: MindBridge turns everyday data into clear, actionable insight, helping you understand your patients better and prepare every consultation.

landing.help.step3.title: You see the important changes
landing.help.step3.desc: At a glance, spot the points of attention and the key trends.
